title: One call, many requests
description: Switch retries on or off at the runtime and the client library, and compare how many requests one failing tool call can send with what the runtime trace records.
initialCaption: Suppose every attempt of one tool call fails. Count the amber slips at the service, then switch a retry layer off.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: If every attempt fails, a runtime allowing 2 attempts above a client library allowing 3 (a first try plus two retries) can send up to 6 requests for one tool call, while the runtime trace shows only 2. Giving retries to one layer limits this to 2 or 3 requests; with no retries a timeout leaves an unknown outcome to report.
